title: Communication And Counselling In Hiv Aids
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a warm, friendly and understanding condition, which is essential for an effective relationship between a client and a counselor."
Rapport is a warm, friendly and understanding condition, which is essential for an effective relationship between a client and a counselor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a real or perceived negative response to a person or persons by individuals, communities or society."
HIV/AIDS-related stigma is a real or perceived negative response to a person or persons by individuals, communities or society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the means by which the message is conveyed from source to receiver."
A channel is the means by which the message is conveyed from source to receiver.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in communication: verbal codes and nonverbal codes."
Two major types of codes are used in communication: verbal codes and nonverbal codes.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a systematic arrangement or comprehensive collection of symbols, letters, or words that have arbitrary meanings and are used for communication."
A code is a systematic arrangement or comprehensive collection of symbols, letters, or words that have arbitrary meanings and are used for communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a trained health worker it is not the counsellor's role to give medical advice."
Even if the counsellor is a trained health worker it is not the counsellor's role to give medical advice.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the assistance given to individuals in making intelligent choices and adjustments."
Guidance is the assistance given to individuals in making intelligent choices and adjustments.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to counselling given to an individual after an HIV test is conducted and is given irrespective of what the HIV test result is."
Post test counselling simply refers to counselling given to an individual after an HIV test is conducted and is given irrespective of what the HIV test result is.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the perfect food for babies."
Breast milk is the perfect food for babies.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to almost any kind of human interaction such as talking or demonstrating that is based on a psychological theory of the problem but it does not include medical treatment methods such as medication."

The psychological methods can refer to almost any kind of human interaction such as talking or demonstrating that is based on a psychological theory of the problem but it does not include medical treatment methods such as medication.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a form of therapy in which a trained professional uses method based on psychological theories to help a person with psychological problems."
Psychotherapy is defined as a form of therapy in which a trained professional uses method based on psychological theories to help a person with psychological problems.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the use of two different types of contraceptive by the sexual partners, one worn by the male (condom) while the woman also uses another form of contraceptive."
Dual protection refers to the use of two different types of contraceptive by the sexual partners, one worn by the male (condom) while the woman also uses another form of contraceptive.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a critical situation in which a person is unable to use his/her normal problem solving techniques."
A crisis situation is a critical situation in which a person is unable to use his/her normal problem solving techniques.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a skill which enables the counsellor help, the client prioritize and choose the most pressing problem that they would like to resolve."
Focusing is a skill which enables the counsellor help, the client prioritize and choose the most pressing problem that they would like to resolve.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a short term intervention which focuses on dealing with the immediate situation."
Crisis counselling is a short term intervention which focuses on dealing with the immediate situation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a powerful and discrediting social label that radically changes the way individuals view themselves and are viewed as persons."
Stigma is a powerful and discrediting social label that radically changes the way individuals view themselves and are viewed as persons.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means feeling with a person, understanding why the person is in pain while sympathy means feeling sorry for a person and putting oneself in the others shoe."
Empathy means feeling with a person, understanding why the person is in pain while sympathy means feeling sorry for a person and putting oneself in the others shoe.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a broad term that covers many different functions."
Counseling is a broad term that covers many different functions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any stimulus which inhibits the receiver's accurate perception of a given message."
Noise is any stimulus which inhibits the receiver's accurate perception of a given message.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a face-to-face technique of obtaining information for a variety of purposes."
An interview is a face-to-face technique of obtaining information for a variety of purposes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a temporary emotional state of deep distress caused by some kind of unexpected, real or imagined threat."
A crisis is a temporary emotional state of deep distress caused by some kind of unexpected, real or imagined threat.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the destination of a given message."
The receiver is the destination of a given message.
fib: ______ is a place where counseling is rendered.
physical setting
The physical setting is a place where counseling is rendered.
______ is a type of situation in which communication occurs.
communication context
A communication context is a type of situation in which communication occurs.
______ is the care of the sick at home given by family members or volunteers, in collaboration with professional health care providers.
Home-based care
Home-based care is the care of the sick at home given by family members or volunteers, in collaboration with professional health care providers.
______ is a test that tells if a person is HIV positive or negative by using a simple blood test or at times making use of saliva or urine.
HIV test
The HIV test is a test that tells if a person is HIV positive or negative by using a simple blood test or at times making use of saliva or urine.
______ is concerned with behaviour change and must involve the application of the principles of learning.
Counselling
Counselling is concerned with behaviour change and must involve the application of the principles of learning.
______ is a term that has no consensus definition.
Communication
Communication is a term that has no consensus definition.
______ is the assessment of the relative effectiveness with which goals or objectives are attained in relation to specified standards.
Evaluation
Evaluation is the assessment of the relative effectiveness with which goals or objectives are attained in relation to specified standards.
______ is the first contact with the client and as the old adage goes "first impression last longest", so it is with clients.
Greeting
Greeting is the first contact with the client and as the old adage goes "first impression last longest", so it is with clients.
______ are a set of guidelines to help prevent people from infecting themselves while caring for a person who may have a communicable disease.
universal precautions
The universal precautions are a set of guidelines to help prevent people from infecting themselves while caring for a person who may have a communicable disease.
______ refers to conducting a review of clients' risk of HIV infection.
Risk assessment
Risk assessment refers to conducting a review of clients' risk of HIV infection.
______ refers to a psychological phenomenon where the client starts to develop feelings for the counsellor.
Transference
Transference refers to a psychological phenomenon where the client starts to develop feelings for the counsellor.
______ is the stimulus which the source or sender transmits to the receiver.
message
A message is the stimulus which the source or sender transmits to the receiver.
______ is a message received and understood and it is probably our greatest possession.
Information
Information is a message received and understood and it is probably our greatest possession.
______ is a way for the client to ventilate whatever emotion he/she is feeling.
crying
The crying is a way for the client to ventilate whatever emotion he/she is feeling.
______ is a retrovirus, which inserts itself via genetic code into T4 helper cells, which co-ordinate the body's immune defence system.
HIV
HIV is a retrovirus, which inserts itself via genetic code into T4 helper cells, which co-ordinate the body's immune defence system.
______ refers to counseling given to an individual prior to taking an HIV test.
Pre-test counselling simply
Pre-test counselling simply refers to counseling given to an individual prior to taking an HIV test.
______ is derived from the learning theory.
Behavioural approach for instance
Behavioural approach for instance is derived from the learning theory.
______ is defined as the process of taking an already conceived idea and getting it ready for transmission.
Encoding
Encoding is defined as the process of taking an already conceived idea and getting it ready for transmission.
______ is any form of behaviour towards a person living with HIV/AIDS that leaves the individual feeling unwanted or dejected.
Stigma in terms of HIV/AIDS
Stigma in terms of HIV/AIDS is any form of behaviour towards a person living with HIV/AIDS that leaves the individual feeling unwanted or dejected.
______ is a term that can be used to describe any event that includes loss, so this could mean losing a job or the death of someone you know.
Bereavement

______ is the originator of a message.
source
